selection_rules.freshness: Assume no previously seen questions; actual per-learner history absent. seen_before_task removes questions by entity ID only. Removing a candidate can change pool proportions, not that candidate key.
selection_rules.weighted_selection: Configured positive easy weight gives uniform choice within the easy band. All rated candidates are easy. Unrated source is unused while easy has positive weight. Unconfigured policy returns lowest entity ID. Positive easy is a conditional scenario, not a claim about an unavailable learner policy.
selection_rules.published_batch: No entity IDs assigned to new records read-only; therefore exact post-insertion seeded mapping cannot be computed. All five are easy; positive-easy weighted selection gives equal conditional probability among the five. Selection cannot introduce a C-unselected record into that five-member subset.

limitations: No database writes or inferred learner history. Captured basis 5356 may change.
Full source+stored pool does contain C-unselected questions; the demonstrated fixed-C cue is confined to the exact incoming five-record batch and the reconstructed five non-source stored records.
No live entity IDs or learner policy were available for new records; exact future seed-to-entity mapping is unavailable, but the within-easy distribution and invariant are independent of those IDs.
